title: Smokestack game
author: shre14uses
selftext:
I made a game about the life of an Indian industrialist. 🏭  
You start in 1991 with one small unit and a bank loan. Every year brings a choice:  
💰 Pay the 3% "commission" to win the tender, or bid clean and lose?  
⚙️ Use cheaper raw material, or protect quality?  
👨‍👩‍👧 Keep the family happy, or keep the business clean?  
Then real history hits: liberalisation, the 2008 crash, the note ban, GST, COVID. Old decisions come back years later. The CBI may knock. Banks rate you, partners can vote you out, and the NCLT is waiting if you fail.  
12 industries, from transformers and textiles to pharma, cement and tiles, with real industry margins. With Claude writing the stories, no two lives play the same.  
How far would you get, and how clean would you stay? 👇
